stem.text: Sulthiame is a molecule that inhibits carbonic anhydrase.
Which effect would sulthiame have inside a red blood cell in muscle tissue that is respiring at a high rate?

A.text: a decrease in the rate of formation of haemoglobinic acid

C.text: an increase in the rate of the chloride shift

D.text: an increase in the dissociation of oxyhaemoglobin
